messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: High error rate & quota thrashing detected on multi-route traffic. Affected routes: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank. Error spikes started 3m ago. Trigger: quota_enforcement_anomaly.
samira (oncall): paging in. What's the customer impact? Which routes are worst?
leo (eng-sre): chat showing lots of 429s from edge quota service; embeddings intermittent 5xxs because downstream queueing; rerank latency skyrocketed for free tier users. Looks like a bug in recently deployed quota-merger logic that double-applies per-route limits on some replicas.
mina (platform): confirmed: a flag landed 2h ago that changed quota propagation semantics. Some edge replicas now apply both edge and origin quotas leading to effective halves/doubles depending on order. Rolling back flag would fix but it's risky across regions.
ash (product): priority: minimize customer-visible failures. Protect enterprise tenants and paid customers first. Free/trial can take degraded experience for short window.
rafa (support): getting tickets from a few enterprise customers seeing degraded chat completions. We need to identify if they were in the impacted replica cohort.
pd-bot: PagerDuty alert: oncall schedule filled. Samira assigned.
samira (oncall): mitigation strategy (ordered):
1) apply route-specific emergency presets from Console: reduce free tier concurrency, raise enterprise quotas for chat/embeddings/rerank, and enable 'soft_429' mode that returns Retry-After and guidance instead of client-facing 5xx.
2) target noisy keys with per-key caps rather than global hard limits.
3) if needed, toggle quota-merger-flag off in a controlled canary.
Would like quick ack to proceed.
leo (eng-sre): I'll prepare the emergency preset payloads. Sample JSON for Console API: 
```
POST /internal/emergency_presets
{
  "name": "quota-fix-2200",
  "routes": {
    "/v1/chat/completions": {"free_concurrency":5, "paid_concurrency":60, "enterprise_concurrency":400},
    "/v1/embeddings": {"free_rpm":120, "paid_rpm":2400, "enterprise_rpm":20000},
    "/v1/rerank": {"free_allow":false, "paid_allow":true, "enterprise_allow":true}
  },
  "soft_429": true
}
```
mina (platform): I can apply that as a canary to the impacted AZs (eu-west-2, us-east-1a) first. I'll exclude enterprise keys explicitly.
ash (product): confirm exclude enterprise keys. Also flag any partner integration keys so we can notify partners if they get soft 429s.
rafa (support): I'll start a short customer message and CSM briefing. Template ready: "We're applying temporary per-route throttles to stabilize platform; paid and enterprise customers prioritized; embeddings unaffected for enterprise."
samira (oncall): apply canary at 2200003420. Monitor error-rate, retry storm signals, and per-key error concentration.
incident-bot: EVENT: emergency preset quota-fix-2200 applied (canary) by mina at 2200003420 to 10% of edge replicas.
leo (eng-sre): canary cohort metrics: chat 429s down 40% in cohort, embeddings 5xx down 35% in cohort, rerank latency better where free_allow=false. Overall region still at 8% error because coverage low.
mina (platform): scaling canary to 35% at 2200003525. We're seeing a lot of client retries causing queue-pressure. Suggest adding `Retry-After: 3` on soft 429s to give backpressure.
samira (oncall): add advisory header for internal clients too: `X-Backpressure: true` so internal pipelines (identified via tag) can back off automatically.
mina (platform): header patch applied at 2200003550.
leo (eng-sre): identifying heavy keys now. Top offender: `sk-int-ALPHA` (internal analytics) responsible for 38% of 429s on chat and 46% of rerank load. Recommend immediate per-key throttle for that key: concurrent 10, rpm 50.
mina (platform): applying per-key caps: 
```
PATCH /internal/keys/sk-int-ALPHA/limits
{ "concurrency": 10, "rpm": 50, "soft": true }
```
incident-bot: EVENT: per-key soft cap applied at 2200003590 by mina.
rafa (support): notified partner ops for `sk-int-ALPHA` owner; they're confirming backoff changes.
leo (eng-sre): great effect: region-wide 429s drop to 3.2%, embeddings 5xx to 1.1%. Note: some enterprise customers still seeing 429s due to tag mismatch on a small set of keys. Investigating.
samira (oncall): urgent: list enterprise keys that hit 429s in the last 10m. We must exclude them ASAP.
mina (platform): fetching... keys `sk-ent-07`, `sk-ent-14` showed 429s because they were routed to a mis-tagged edge replica. Remapping those keys to correct replica pool now. 
mina (platform): remap applied at 2200003695.
leo (eng-sre): verified enterprise keys now excluded; affected customers should recover. Sending targeted note to CSMs for the two keys.
rafa (support): sending targeted messages.
samira (oncall): next: should we toggle quota-merger-flag off entirely? It's the root cause but broad rollback may regress other fixes. Plan: leave canary presets in place for 30m while we validate. If the canary continues to reduce errors by >50% and no negative side effects, then we'll perform a staged rollback of quota-merger-flag in non-prod first then prod. Need approval.
mina (platform): agree. I'll prepare a staged rollback runbook: non-prod -> us regions -> rest of world. Estimate 20-30m for full safe rollback.
ash (product): ok. Also log request: add per-route emergency presets to Console UI with one-click application. This took too long to compose.
leo (eng-sre): we should also add an automatic per-key scoring signal: if a key causes >25% of route errors for 2m, auto-apply a soft cap and notify the key owner. Filing that as action item.
samira (oncall): monitoring for 15 more minutes then will hand off to Leo at 2200004120. Whoever takes over, include timeline and all mitigation commands in incident doc.
incident-bot: METRIC: after per-key cap and canary scaling, region-wide errors down to 0.6% and P95 latencies within baseline for 8m.
mina (platform): noting one follow-up: add a safety label for enterprise keys to never be routed to replicas with the new quota-merge mode until we fix the propagation bug.
rafa (support): cumulative affected: ~9k chat 429s, ~3k embeddings 5xx, rerank ~6k degraded calls. Two enterprise keys briefly impacted but remapped quickly. CSMs notified.
samira (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline at 2200004120; Leo will be incident lead. Post-incident actions: 1) rollback or patch quota-merger logic; 2) expose Console emergency presets and one-click dials; 3) implement per-key auto-throttle heuristics and notifications; 4) ensure enterprise key tags have stronger invariants; 5) add a runbook for Retry-After and backpressure headers.
leo (eng-sre): acknowledged. Creating incident doc in #incidents with commands, timestamps, and per-customer impact. Will schedule RCA with platform and eng-ml.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: quota-thrashing mitigations stabilized platform at 2200004120.
